requirements.text: * Experience shipping a consumer product as an engineer, including an app or digital product used by real customers.
* Must have proven full-stack production engineering ability.
* Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React.
* Experience with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and/or Python as stated in the hard requirements.
* A track record of shipping fast and reliable code with AI tools.
* A degree from a top-tier university in engineering, science, math, or a related field, or equivalent experience demonstrated through shipped work.
* High ambition, hunger, and drive to take ownership in a demanding, fast-moving environment.

This is a broad, high-ownership role for an engineer who has already shipped a consumer product used by real customers and wants to build quickly across the full stack. You will work onsite in San Francisco in a highly collaborative environment.
